# P16 evidence/time recovery checkpoint

Completed bounded author work: all 18 evidence and 37 time examples inspected
against contract clauses; versioned repairs and complete result note saved.
This is PARTIAL P16, awaiting independent bounded_partial_work review. Product
implementation remains disabled; no architecture or human acceptance is implied.

The reviewed comparator was accepted P15 requirements and the evidence/time
recovery plan, not prototype defaults. The skeptical audit rejected counts as
semantic evidence and kept synthetic examples distinct from real source conflict.
The old progress note was stale: both contracts/fixtures and architecture.json
already existed. Latest structured P15 review accepts the full audit; older
checkpoint prose does not control that status.

positive_assets. T-harmonised-assumption expected a conditional result without a
selected assumption; time v2 explicitly selects bridge-assumed, states synthetic
transform support/dependencies and uses the documented record_subset operation.

every fixture and records source, authority and runtime limits.

19 reference occurrences and 55 fixture IDs; final input hashes match. The v2
consistency report preserves the prior verification-note snapshot. Registered
